main_text.head: LECTORI CHRI-STIANO S.

p.i: VT integram Centuriam primā haberes, viginti duos Characteres ex Apostolicis viris prioribus adiūngere visum est. Ceterum illud animadvertas velim, ante aliquot annos variis scriptis à Iesuitica secta editis Ecclesia Christiana Pastores infinitis conuiciis fuisse laceratos. Maledictis autem certare cum isto sodalitio non est nobis constitutum: illis tantum regerimus, quod olim insignis Philosophus cuidam Sophistae respondit, qui conquisitis multis futilibus argumentis probare conabatur, Philosophum illum non esse animal rationale: Conclude (inquit) de te quod de me dixisti, & verum dixeris. Reposuimus ergo veros Characteres ex sacris literis, quos quotidiana experientia, mores, conatus & scripta Iesuitarum huic secta ante alias omnes omninò conuenire testantur, & posteritati nostrae (nisi Deus talem mundo pe-stem averterit) amplius testabuntur.

page.notes: <note side="right">IESVITARVM.</note> Doubtful readings: "Conclude" (possibly with an accent); "averterit" in the last line, read as "anerterit" in print, with the letter after "an" uncertain. The run-in label "Metuendus impetus" is set in italic with a decorative initial; it is treated as running text, not a heading. The first paragraph's large initial "V" is joined to "T" as "VT". The paragraph continues on the next page, so no catchword is shown.
